verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents controlling a task from app.humanlayer.com on a phone while the agent runs on a remote host, and its workflows include review points. However, no evidence shows a specific approve/deny flow for key agent decisions from mobile, or agents continuing to work while waiting for that approval. missing for 10: documented mobile approval prompts for agent decisions, evidence of non-blocking approval while agents keep working, push notifications for pending approvals, hands-on corroboration of phone use.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can approve key agent decisions from my phone while agents continue working

citations.quote: You will control the task from app.humanlayer.com on a machine or phone.
The host can be a cloud VM, workstation, or private-network machine.
Select the shortest workflow that gives you the review points you need.
Reviewers can comment on synced documents in HumanLayer
